provenance.author: Michel de Messieres
provenance.method: projection monotonicity applied to the exact rank-2 exclusion at m=5

compute.hardware: none beyond the m=5 certificate, which this cell re-runs

notes: chi(cat_6) >= chi(cat_5) >= 3. (I (x) <0|)|cat_6> = 2^{-1/2}|cat_5>, checked by the certificate on the exact amplitudes, and <0| on one qubit carries a stabilizer decomposition to one with no more terms (the projection lemma of cert_s_m4_from_m3.py), so the rank is non-decreasing in m; chi(cat_5) >= 3 is the exact exclusion of bounds/cat-m5-lower-3.json, which the same script re-runs (about 8 s). Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset (arXiv:2106.07740) give the same argument from their Lemma 3. With bounds/cat-m6-upper-3.json the cell is exact, chi(cat_6) = 3, as in their Table 1 and in the text after Theorem 1 ("the stabilizer rank of |cat_6> is exactly 3").
